questions.q:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

98, 95, 86, 82, 66, ?, 36
questions.solution:
Pattern followed is:

98 – 3 = 95

95 - 3² = 86

86 – 4 = 82

82 - 4² = 66

66 – 5 = 61

61 - 5² = 36

Hence 61 is the correct answer.

questions.q:
Two statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement.

Statements:

No crows is a bird.

All birds are animals.

Conclusion:

I. Some animals are crows.

II. Some animals are birds.

III. No animal is a crow.
options: Conclusion II and either conclusion I or III follows
Only conclusions I and III follow
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:



Conclusion:

Some animals are crows → False (Possibility but not definitely true).

Some animals are birds → True.

No animal is a crow → False (Possibility but not definitely true).

Thus, I and III forms a complimentary pair.

Hence, Conclusion II and either conclusion I or III follows.

questions.q: Which of the following destroys the ozone layer?
questions.solution:
• Chlorofluorocarbons(CFCs) contain Chlorine. It reacts with ozone as follows: - Cl + O₃ → ClO + O₂. The important part is O₃(ozone) gets converted to O₂.(oxygen). CFCs have been phased out. Ozone blocks harmful UV rays from reaching earth. It is present in the stratosphere.

• Montreal Protocol → Agreement among member states to protect the Ozone layer.

• Ozone day is celebrated on September 16th and 2018 was themed "Keep Cool and Carry On".

questions.q: A and B are travelling towards each other from the points P and Q respectively. After crossing each other, A and B take 681​ hours and 8 hours, respectively, to reach their destinations Q and P, respectively. If the speed of B is 16.8 km/h, then the speed (in km/hr) of A is:
questions.solution:
If A and B after crossing each other takes x and y hours, respectively, to reach their destinations then the ratio of their speed will be

(Speed of A) / (speed of B) = √(y/x)

According to the question

Speed of A/16.8 = √[8 ÷ (49/8)]

⇒ Speed of A/16.8 = √([8 × 8)/49] = 8/7

⇒ Speed of A = 8/7 × 16.8 = 19.2 km/hr

questions.q: A circle is inscribed in ΔABC, touching AB at P, BC at Q and AC at R. If AR = 5 cm, RC = 6 cm and AB = 12 cm, then the perimeter of ΔABC is:
questions.solution:
As we know, AR = AP, BP = BQ and QC = CR

⇒ AR = AP = 5cm and CR = QC = 6cm

⇒ AB = AP + BP

⇒ BP = 12 – 5 = 7

⇒ BP = BQ = 7cm

∴ Perimeter of triangle = AR + RC + QC + QB + BP + AP = 5 + 6 + 6 + 7 + 7 + 5 = 36 cm

questions.q: The average of thirteen numbers is 80. The average of the first five numbers is 74.5 and that of the next five numbers is 82.5. The 11th numbers is 6 more than the 12th number and the 12th number is 6 less than the 13th number. What is the average of the 11th and the 13th numbers?
questions.solution:
Average of 13 numbers = 80

⇒ Sum of 13 numbers = 80 × 13 = 1040

Average of the first 5 numbers = 74.5

⇒ Sum of the first 5 numbers = 74.5 × 5 = 372.5

Average of next five numbers (6th to 10th) = 82.5

⇒ Sum of the next five numbers (6th to 10th) = 82.5 × 5 = 412.5

⇒ Sum of the last 3 numbers = 1040 – 372.5 – 412.5 = 255

Let the 12th number be x.

11th numbers = x + 6 and 13th number = x + 6

According to the question

⇒ x + 6 + x + x + 6 = 255

⇒ x = 81

⇒ 11th number = x + 6 = 81 + 6 = 87

⇒ x + 6 = 81 + 6 = 87

∴ Average of 11th and 13th number = (87 + 87)/2 = 87

questions.q: If ab + bc + ca = 8 and a² + b² + c² = 20, then a possible value of 1/2 × (a + b + c)[(a – b)² + (b – c)² + (c – a)²] is:
questions.solution:
Given:

ab + bc + ca = 8 and a² + b² + c² = 20

Formula used:

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca)

Calculation:

(a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ (a + b + c)² = 20 + 2 × 8 = 36

⇒ (a + b + c) = 6

Now,

1/2 × (a + b + c)[(a – b)² + (b – c)² + (c – a)²]

⇒ 1/2(a + b + c)(a² + b² – 2ab + b2 + c2 – 2bc + c2 + a2 – 2ac)

⇒ 1/2(a + b + c)[2(a2 + b2 + c2) – 2(ab + bc + ac)]

Now substituting the values,

⇒ (a + b + c)[(a2 + b2 + c2) – (ab + bc + ac)]

⇒ 6(20 – 8)

⇒ 6 × 12 = 72

∴ The required answer is 72.

questions.q:
In the sentence identify the segment which contains the grammatical error.

Every employee of the company were given a two-bedroom flat as a Diwali bonus.
questions.solution:
Method:
1. Identify the subject of the sentence.
2. Check if the subject is singular or plural.
3. Match the subject with the correct verb form (Subject-Verb Agreement).

Explanation:
The subject of the sentence is "Every employee". In English grammar, words like Every, Each, and Everyone are always considered singular. Since the subject is singular, the verb must also be singular. Therefore, "were given" (plural) must be replaced with "was given" (singular).

Why the others are wrong:
(A) as a Diwali bonus is grammatically correct as it functions as a prepositional phrase.
(B) a two-bedroom flat is correct as it uses a hyphenated compound adjective to describe the noun.
(C) Every employee is the correct subject form; the error lies in the verb that follows it.
